bagPolicy.summary: Only clear totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or nonclear clutches up to 6 × 9 inches may enter. There is no bag check at the gates.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking is included with a concert ticket. EZ Out, Front Row and Ultra Premier are paid upgrades; oversized vehicles need an advance pass.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Drop-off and pickup areas are inside the entrance to the Darien Lake Theme Park parking lots.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are available for purchase; each guest may bring food in a clear one-gallon bag. The allowed-items guide lists event-specific water restrictions.
allowed: Food in one clear one-gallon bag
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible pickup and drop-off are inside the theme park parking entrance; contact the amphitheater for seating and arrival support.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The amphitheater visitor guide does not publish a general rule for re-entry after leaving a concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is available when doors are open; bring photo ID, including for artist guest-list tickets.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The venue guide does not publish one universal gate-opening time; consult the concert listing. Will Call opens with doors.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
